lines.text: Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.

data.define: To cost so much that you can't afford it.

example.text: Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.

misuse.text: Don't say 'break the bank' at a bank.
misuse.why: It only means costing too much.

data.l1_ex: 别担心，这顿午餐不会 "break the bank"。
